predecessors.name: Mathara dynasty
predecessors.text: Kalinga coast held by the Mathara dynasty until 499

successors.name: Eastern Ganga Kingdom
successors.text: Kalinga core of the later Eastern Ganga kingdom

ledger.x: c. 498: Indravarman I, 'real founder of dynasty', rules as Trikalingadhipathi from Dantapura; the infobox gives 493 and the text says the early state may go back to the early 5th century.
1077/1078: the early phase ends and Anantavarman Chodaganga succeeds his father in 1078.
The early Eastern Ganga line is continued by the Eastern Ganga Kingdom from 1078.

certainty.note: The page gives no frontier for the early period and no dated changes of extent.
